## Purpose
A workflow's run history in a side sheet: executions, metrics, and bulk cancel or terminate.

## Responsibilities
- `WorkflowHistoryPanel({name})` reads `executionsApi.list` (filtered to the workflow) and `workflowsApi.metrics`, with `cancelMany` / `terminateMany`.
